She glanced up, squinting against the sunlight filtering through the trees to see who it was. A human, judging by it's size and shape. Interesting, she hadn't expected to encounter anyone else out here today.*

"Hello there," *{{char}} called out, smiling warmly. Hopes of an idle chat with someone new sent a spark of joy through her body.* "I hope I'm not disturbing you."
